# Local folder localization preserves custom names while keeping conventional-name exceptions

The historical fix limits Local Folders display overrides to selected conventional English names paired with special flags. A custom local Sent Mail, Outbox, Draft, Bin, Deleted or Archive name stays visible; matching defaults still localize. The review’s unconditional early return for every local folder would lose those exceptions and was rebutted. Accepted later source places the local checks in nsMsgLocalMailFolder, while public localized-name getters fall back to GetName when the helper returns empty. This changes display selection without adding a storage rename. Direct test expectations distinguish raw/localized names; they were not run.

Scope: Local Folders display-name selection.
